audit.whatIsWrong: The page calls Olaf's W 'Vicious Strikes' in four places and describes it as lifesteal that heals him through your beams. Both the name and the effect are wrong.
audit.why: Olaf's W is Tough It Out (16/15/14/13/12s): increased Attack Speed and a Shield — no healing at all. The lifesteal is on the passive, Berserker Rage, and it scales with missing Health, so it arrives when he is already low rather than during the chip phase. Telling a player to anti-heal a shield is advice that loses the trade.
audit.corrected: Tough It Out named and described as a shield in whys[1], whys[3], mid and wants.foe[2]; Berserker Rage credited with the lifesteal in dosFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ragnarok was summarised as 'CC-immune — your stun won't hold him', with no cooldown and no condition. Undertow's reset had no number either.
audit.why: Riot's text is that he is immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking — break contact and the immunity ends, which is precisely the sequencing this matchup needs. Ragnarok is 100/90/80s; Undertow is a flat 9s that resets outright if he picks the axe up.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now gives Ragnarok 100s with the keeps-attacking condition, Undertow 9s with the pickup reset, and your grenade at 11s; dontsFull[1].d and dosFull[2].d carry the axe numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: diff read EVEN at 8.5/10 with report[14] calling it a 'Hard matchup' — in a 61.31% lane whose own prose says 'This is your stranglehold' and 'You stay favored'. The chart also gave Heimerdinger Level 1, which the page's own whys[0] contradicts.
audit.why: Packet chart is [Olaf, Skill, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger] and whys[0], whys[1], whys[3] and whys[5] already read that way. Only the enums were stale.
audit.corrected: diff EVEN -> FAV, diffRating 8.5/10 -> 4/10, difficulty and final-rating lines matched. Rows 0 -> Olaf, 1 -> Skill, 3 -> Heimerdinger, 5 -> Heimerdinger in both layers, with ratings and phase whys.

audit.why: Four spikes and they are the right four: his Level 1, your 4-5 nest peak, your Level 6 UPGRADE!!! answer to Ragnarok, and his late true-damage catch window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal was prescribed against a shield that does not heal.
audit.why: Grievous Wounds still has a target here — Berserker Rage lifesteal, which spikes as he drops low — but the burst-absorbing thing to play around is the Tough It Out shield on 16s, and the right answer to a shield is baiting it, not anti-heal (flagged missing interaction).
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d now separates the two: anti-heal for the passive lifesteal, bait for the 16s shield.

edits.after: Your peak: three charges plus the stun grenade delete any all-in, and he cannot pick an axe back up while frozen in the nest.

edits.before: This is your stranglehold. With three turret charges and the CH-3X Lightning Grenade (E), any commit from Olaf is suicide: land the center-stun, let three buildings beam him while he's frozen and can't grab an axe, and his Reckless Swing can't out-DPS the nest. His one trick is Ragnarok (R), which makes him CC-immune so your grenade whiffs and his Vicious Strikes (W) heals him through the beams; so hold the stun, bait the R, and at 6 UPGRADE!!! the wider grenade to lock him the second his immunity ends.
edits.after: This is your stranglehold. With three turret charges and the CH-3X Lightning Grenade (E), any commit from Olaf is suicide: land the center-stun, let three buildings beam him while he's frozen and can't grab an axe, and his Reckless Swing can't out-DPS the nest. His one trick is Ragnarok (R, 100s), which makes him disable-immune only while he keeps attacking and pairs with the Tough It Out (W) shield; so hold the stun, bait the R, and at 6 UPGRADE!!! the wider grenade to lock him the second his immunity ends.

notes: REAL FABRICATION FOUND: this matchup called Olaf's W 'Vicious Strikes' (an old name) and described it as lifesteal. The live W is Tough It Out — attack speed plus a SHIELD, no healing — and the lifesteal lives on the passive, Berserker Rage. Worth grepping the whole repo for 'Vicious Strikes'; if other champions' Olaf pages inherited the same template line, they carry the same error. Not asserted (kit is silent): whether Ragnarok's disable-immunity cleanses a stun already applied, and exactly how long after he stops attacking the immunity lapses.
